summary_en: 1,599,686 shares acquired at ¥5,200/share (¥8.32B total) from tender offer of Ryomou Systems. Minimum threshold of 537,260 shares exceeded. MITSUBA to hold 80% economic interest, Chubu Electric Power 20%. Tender period 15 May – 8 July 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding results of tender offer for common shares of Ryomou Systems Inc. (Securities code: 9691)
translation_en_brief: On 9 July 2026, MITSUBA Corporation and Chubu Electric Power Co. announced completion of a tender offer for common shares of Ryomou Systems Inc. (TSE Standard market, code 9691). The offer ran from 15 May to 8 July 2026 and targeted up to 1,703,447 shares (representing all shares held by public shareholders after excluding MITSUBA's pre-existing stake of 1,795,040 shares and Ryomou Systems' treasury of 11,513 shares). The tender price was fixed at ¥5,200 per share. The offer succeeded: 1,599,686 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 537,260 shares. Total acquisition value is approximately ¥8.32 billion. Under the agreed allocation, MITSUBA will acquire up to 1,003,800 shares (80% stake objective) and Chubu Electric Power will acquire the remainder (20% stake objective). No upper limit was set on share acquisition. The joint offerors intend to establish MITSUBA as the controlling shareholder with an 80% voting interest and Chubu Electric Power as a significant minority shareholder with 20%.
